text: If anyone asks you to pay with a gift card, it's a scam. Every time.
The FTC says it plainly. No real business or government agency will ever ask for one.
The call sounds urgent. The IRS, tech support, your power is about to be cut off.
They keep you on the phone while you buy the cards. Sometimes at several stores.
Then they ask for the number and the pin on the back.
That's all they need. The money can be gone in minutes
while the card is still in your hand. Why gift cards? They're fast, hard to trace, and
almost impossible to reverse. Americans report losing over $200 million a year this way.
That's the mirage. The card in your hand feels like money you still have. It's already
spent. Gift cards are for gifts, not payments. This is money mirage. Follow for more.
